title: 营销渠道转化与获客成本
context: 营销负责人希望评估不同渠道效率。
requirements: 以2025-01-01至2025-12-31发生的访问会话为观察总体，按会话渠道归因。转化会话是这些会话中截至2025-12-31关联至少一张有效线上订单的不同会话，转化率=转化会话数/观察会话数。新客仅计历史首次有效线上订单在该观察会话内发生且订单日期在2025年的客户，首次按订单日期、订单编号决胜。净收入广告回报的收入同样只取观察会话内2025年有效线上订单的净额。广告支出按渠道2025年月份汇总，获客成本=广告支出/新客数。保留全部渠道，无会话和无转化计0，缺少广告预算记录的支出及相关比率为NULL，零分母为NULL。获客成本保留2位、回报倍数4位、百分比2位小数。
commonError: 跨年会话不能只凭订单日期进入当年转化分子；不同订单共享会话时会话只计一次。
executionSteps: 确定期间访问会话总体
在完整历史上识别首购
在同一会话总体内统计转化和净收入
独立汇总广告支出并保留无访问渠道
mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT source_id,COUNT(*) sessions FROM customer_sessions WHERE session_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY source_id), o AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online'), a AS (SELECT t.source_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id) converted,SUM(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) new_customers,SUM(net_cents) net FROM o JOIN customer_sessions t ON t.session_id=o.session_id WHERE t.session_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t.source_id), p AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(s.sessions,0) sessions,COALESCE(a.converted,0) converted,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.converted,0)/NULLIF(s.sessions,0),2) conversion_pct,COALESCE(a.new_customers,0) new_customers,p.spend spend_cents,ROUND(1.0*p.spend/NULLIF(a.new_customers,0),2) cac_cents,ROUND(1.0*a.net/NULLIF(p.spend,0),4) roas FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN s ON s.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN p ON p.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY t.source_id
